about: The 1989 bank vault as a modular kit: the round door #1 in its frame and wall (VaultFront and VaultDoor), the steel room behind it (VaultRoom), the deposit box wall (VaultDepositWall) and the cash trolley (VaultCashTrolley). Built by build.py in headless Blender; only the door detail is generated (tools/assets/vault-front, Meshy image-to-3D from front concept 1).

generated.note: Measured on the raw model (Blender axes, model units): door centre x 0.025 z 0, door radius 0.675, wall face y 0.045, hinge barrel axis x -0.75 y -0.054; the front faces -Y.

layout_m.about: Enfusion metres: x right, y up, z forward. The door faces +z; the room lies behind the wall at -z.

door.about: Meshy marks most of the painted door as metal, so there are no regions: the paint keeps a little of Meshy's metal for the wheel and bolts and stays matt (docs/style-guide.md: steel is dull).
